cycle_probe.interpretation: Partial cycle correspondence, not a timing calibration. No reference shifts applied; high-pass delay compensation unresolved.
cycle_probe.method:
Inspect five deterministic training-only raw LAR intervals; not a scorer.

    Probe midpoints of the five longest reference-positive runs, using 32 ms
    centered raw first-difference windows. Select the shortest local ACF peak
    within 90% of the largest normalized peak in 50..700 Hz. This exploratory
    cycle check cannot establish boundary timing or filter-delay compensation.

git_payload_policy: Metadata identities, aggregate audits and small numerical probes only; no corpus media, reference trajectories, or prompt text committed.
reproduction: cd research/voice-prosody && .venv/bin/python -m phenometrix_prosody.data acquire --split train --per-speaker 2 --roles mic,ref,lar
uncertainties: 16+10*k ms is the report/Snack nominal grid, not independently validated physiological boundary timing.
Report gives a linear-phase Kaiser high-pass n=2400 but no filter invocation, compensation, crop, or producer-version record; a roughly25ms causal group delay is possible, not established.
Reference tail is54ms in every pilot file; do not extrapolate reference rows or confuse missing tail with unvoiced truth.
Pilot includes F0 below documented Snack60Hz default, so manual defaults do not establish production reference range.
Cycle probes show partial raw-sensor/reference correspondence but cannot choose a fixed timestamp correction.
No development or sealed-test audio/reference content acquired. No model benchmark or clinical claim is established.
